message.content:
Closures are a nightmare because they’re *always* changing. One minute, the system says a zone’s closed until noon, and the next, it gets widened or the end time gets pushed back—sometimes while drones are already in the air.

We’ve had cases where a closure was supposed to lift at 14:00, but by 13:45, it got extended to 16:00. Or a sudden closure pops up because of a VIP event, and we’ve got to reroute *right now*. The worst part? The updates don’t always come in time, or the drones don’t report their position properly, so we’re playing catch-up half the time.

We just need to know *exactly* what’s closed, when, and where—no guesswork. If a drone’s already in a closing zone, we’ve got to pull it *before* it gets caught in it. No room for mistakes.
